parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the query list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为50行。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The disk status.

In-use: in use
Available: to be mounted
Attaching: being mounted
Detaching: being unmounted
Creating: being created
ReIniting: being reset
Deleting: being released
Deleted: released
Expiring: about to expire
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘状态。

In-use：使用中
Available：待挂载
Attaching：挂载中
Detaching：卸载中
Creating：创建中
ReIniting：重置中
Deleting：释放中
Deleted：已释放
Expiring：即将过期
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The disk property.

system: system cloud disk
data: data cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘属性

system：系统盘
data：数据盘
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The disk category.

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
cloud_ssd: all-flash cloud disk
local_hdd: local HDD
local_ssd: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘种类。

高效云盘：cloud_efficiency
全闪云盘：cloud_ssd
本地HDD盘：local_hdd
本地盘SSD：local_ssd
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The billing type.

prepay: subscription
postpay: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型。

prepay：预付费
postpay：按量付费
parameters.name: disk_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The sorting parameter. Format example: {"EnsRegionId":"desc"}. By default, results are sorted by edge zone ID in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序使用：格式例子{"EnsRegionId":"desc"}。默认按节点ID降序排列
parameters.name: order_by_params

parameters.help_en:
The disk purchase method.

ServiceDisk: disk created by an edge service
ResoureDisk: purchased with an instance
PostPayDisk: purchased separately
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘购买方式。

ServiceDisk：边缘服务创建磁盘
ResoureDisk：随实例购买
PostPayDisk：单独购买
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The instance to which the cloud disk is mounted
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en: The returned business code. A value of 0 indicates success
Code.description_zh: 返回的业务码，正常成功为0

Category.description_en:
The disk category.

cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
cloud_ssd: all-flash cloud disk
local_hdd: local HDD
local_ssd: local SSD
Category.description_zh:
磁盘种类。

高效云盘：cloud_efficiency
全闪云盘：cloud_ssd
本地HDD盘：local_hdd
本地盘SSD：local_ssd

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。时间格式以ISO8601为标准，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the disk is released together with the instance. Valid values:

true: The disk is released together with the instance.
false: The disk is retained when the instance is released
DeleteWithInstance.description_zh:
是否随实例释放。可能值：

true：释放实例时，这块磁盘随实例一起释放。
false：释放实例时，这块磁盘保留不释放

DiskChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the cloud disk or local disk. Valid values:

prepaid: subscription.
postpaid: pay-as-you-go
DiskChargeType.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘的计费方式。取值：

prepaid：包年包月。
postpaid：按量付费

Encrypted.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud disk is encrypted. Valid values:

true: Encrypted.

false: Not encrypted
Encrypted.description_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

EncryptedKeyId.description_en: The KMS key ID used by the cloud disk
EncryptedKeyId.description_zh: 云盘使用的 KMS 密钥 ID

Portable.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud disk or local disk supports unmounting. Valid values:

true: Supported. The disk can exist independently and can be freely mounted and unmounted within the zone.
false: Not supported. The disk cannot exist independently and cannot be freely mounted and unmounted within the zone.

The Portable property is false for the following types of block storage, whose lifecycle is the same as the associated instance:

Local HDD
Local SSD
Subscription data cloud disk
Portable.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘是否支持卸载。取值：

true：支持。可以独立存在，且可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。
false：不支持。不可以独立存在，且不可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。

以下类型块存储的Portable属性都为false，生命周期与实例等同：

本地HDD盘
本地SSD盘
包年包月数据盘

Status.description_en:
The disk status.
In-use: in use
Available: to be mounted
Attaching: being mounted
Detaching: being unmounted
Creating: being created
ReIniting: being reset
Status.description_zh:
磁盘状态。
In-use：使用中
Available：待挂载
Attaching：挂载中
Detaching：卸载中
Creating：创建中
ReIniting：重置中

Type.description_en:
The type of the cloud disk or local disk. Valid values:

1: system cloud disk
2: data cloud disk
Type.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘类型。取值：

1：系统盘
2：数据盘

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of pages for a paged query
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时分页总页数
